# IKE & IKZE Poland Guide
> Complete guide to IKE and IKZE individual retirement accounts in Poland for expats and foreign residents.

## Pages
- [Home](https://ike-ikze-poland.com/): Overview of IKE and IKZE accounts
- [IKE Account Guide](https://ike-ikze-poland.com/ike): Full details on IKE — limits, tax benefits, eligibility
- [IKZE Account Guide](https://ike-ikze-poland.com/ikze): Full details on IKZE — limits, tax deduction, 10% withdrawal tax
- [IKE vs IKZE Comparison](https://ike-ikze-poland.com/compare): Side-by-side comparison
- [Savings Calculator](https://ike-ikze-poland.com/calculator): Interactive retirement savings projections
- [Guide for Expats](https://ike-ikze-poland.com/expats): PESEL requirements, English-language providers, what happens if you leave Poland
- [FAQ](https://ike-ikze-poland.com/faq): 12 common questions answered
